SDS_Station_Crew.name: Stardust Station Crew
SDS_Station_Crew.text: The recurring coworkers who keep Stardust Station functioning. Their mismatches, dependencies and forced proximity are the story engine; crystals are consequence, not premise.

SDS_StarTrust.name: StarTrust Extractives
SDS_StarTrust.text: Corporate employer/owner context. Stardust is near low-value shutdown at the start; corporate interest in the material byproduct emerges opportunistically, not from a pre-existing emotional-mining conspiracy.

SDS_Inspection.name: Morale-and-Safety Inspection
SDS_Inspection.text: Routine outside inspection pressure. The inspector is procedural and dry, not an antagonist; the inspection tests whether the crew can function and recover.
